notes:
Clearer error screens: pairing that can't find BOBO, and BOBO offline, now say what happened and what to tap next.
One look for every "Delete?" question, with Cancel as the safe button.
Keyboard and switch users see an orange focus ring on everything they can tap.
BOBO care: one "Update" button with a progress bar, as in the design. Installing from a file moved under "Install from a file".
Your device's own name now shows everywhere (menu titles, help text, chat labels), not "BOBO".
